"""Deterministic recovery of a checkpointed transactional byte journal.

Replay only structurally valid prefix records and only complete, correctly
sealed transactions newer than the supplied checkpoint.

Record layout (all integers unsigned, little-endian):
    payload_length:u32 | sequence:u32 | kind:u8 | transaction_id:u32
    | payload | crc:u32
crc = zlib.crc32(header + payload) & 0xffffffff, header is the 13 fixed bytes.
"""

import json
import sys
import zlib

HEADER_LEN = 13
CRC_LEN = 4
MAX_PAYLOAD = 4096

KIND_BEGIN = 1
KIND_PATCH = 2
KIND_COMMIT = 3
KIND_ABORT = 4


def solve(request):
    pages = [bytearray(bytes.fromhex(p)) for p in request["pages"]]
    checkpoint = request["checkpoint"]
    log_hex = request["log"]
    log = bytes.fromhex(log_hex) if log_hex else b""

    n_pages = len(pages)
    n = len(log)
    pos = 0
    prev_seq = 0
    last_seq = 0
    valid_bytes = 0
    # txid -> [staged_patch_count, running_payload_crc, [(page, offset, data)]]
    active = {}

    while True:
        remaining = n - pos
        if remaining < HEADER_LEN:
            break  # incomplete record header
        header = log[pos:pos + HEADER_LEN]
        payload_length = int.from_bytes(header[0:4], "little")
        sequence = int.from_bytes(header[4:8], "little")
        kind = header[8]
        txid = int.from_bytes(header[9:13], "little")

        if payload_length > MAX_PAYLOAD:
            break  # invalid header
        end = pos + HEADER_LEN + payload_length + CRC_LEN
        if end > n:
            break  # incomplete record body/crc

log = begin(1,1)+patch(2,1,0,0,b"\x7f")+commit(3,1,[pp])
check("1-byte page", solve({"pages":["00"],"checkpoint":0,"log":log.hex()}),
      {"pages":["7f"],"valid_bytes":len(log),"last_seq":3})

# u16 max offsets rejected (structural stop)
